item.title: Students set new records for A-level grades in bumper year
item.summary: Northern Ireland best performing with 30.7% of grades being As and A*s but Wales and England close behind A-level results – latest updates Sixth-formers have basked in a summer of record-breaking exam results in academic and vocational subjects, allowing more than a quarter of a million 18-year-olds to go on to higher education. Students in England set new records for the proportion gaining the highest grades in A-level subjects, with 9.7% gaining A*s, up from 9.4% last year, setting new highs outside of the pandemic era when exams were scrapped.
